notes: v7.9.0: 新增「AI 生词」文案助手（对标微信朋友圈 AI 生词）：竞品级候选文案一键填入，覆盖 Muse/Suno 灵感描述、Muse 大师模式歌词、Melo 歌词方向、Lyrics 创作脚本、发布工坊标题与分享文案；后端新增 /api/ai/captions 分层生成服务（LLM 可选 + 本地词池兜底，零积分消耗）. v7.8.0: Muse AUTO 生成修复（对齐官网真实请求契约：去除 App-Key、极简 body、think 深度思考流、真实 machineId）+ Muse 任务轮询契约修复（taskIds 批量查询与响应规范化）+ 全局悬浮 AUTO 快捷启动按钮（任意页面一键启动 Muse/Suno/Melo 歌曲与 MV 自动生成）+ AUTO 运行时背景压暗聚焦（创作思维面板与进度卡高亮，背景 pointer-events 保留）. v7.7.2: Guest mode fixed (enterGuest real session, was no-op bouncing back to login); /api/suno/music 500 fixed (req.query getter-only assignment via setQuery/defineProperty); verify_webapp.cjs upgraded to full 18-target UI walkthrough (19/19 PASS, 0 console errors); legacy root APKs untracked from git. v7.7.1: Sprint 14 - per-page error boundaries (PageErrorBoundary), frontend error reporting to logs/server.log via POST /api/errors/report, global window.onerror + unhandledrejection capture, server-wide global appender for all Logger instances, Suno model mv parameter (v6/v6-wild/v6-mini replacing rejected chirp-fenix). v7.7.0: v7.7.0: Auth guard blocking unauthenticated dashboard; complete SMS/phone registration flow; Settings autoClose toggles (autoCloseOnStop/autoCloseOnDone/autoCloseDelay) fully wired; registration+login endpoints working end-to-end; codebase audit complete. v7.6.1: Test patch bump - verifying version system. v7.6.0: Auth guard, auto-versioning, settings wiring, chaining fix. v7.5.0 — Documentation & Logging Overhaul Release. (1) PMP-standard documentation suite: new SYSTEM_SPEC.md (50+ functional requirements, 71 non-functional requirements, system boundaries, constraints, acceptance criteria, glossary), new PROGRAM_SPEC.md (5-layer MVC architecture, module specs for all 14 controllers/17 services/18 pages, data flow diagrams, integration points, logging specification, security considerations), new TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md (environment setup, project structure, build & deployment, coding standards, step-by-step guides for adding pages/API endpoints/AI engines, logging usage examples, troubleshooting, version management). (2) Updated USER_GUIDE.md from v5.4.0 to v7.5.0 (25 sections covering all 18 pages, GLOBAL AUTO, 10 strategy presets, lyrics engine, studios, library, quality analyzer, batch gen, analytics, audio player, settings, auth, history, i18n, tips, FAQ, troubleshooting). (3) Updated README.md from v5.4.0 to v7.5.0 (badges, 3 AI engines, live demo links, feature highlights, tech stack table, quick start, project structure, mobile apps, deployment, config, API reference, documentation table linking all 10 docs, screenshots, repo/contact). (4) Updated PMP_PROJECT_PLAN.md from v1.0.0 to v7.5.0 (all 8 phases marked complete, 13 sprints, full version history, updated risk register, issue log summary, updated resources to zwindhuang@qq.com/zwindhuang-opc/zmusic, pinned ports 4720/4721). (5) Updated ISSUE_LOG.md with v7.x resolved issues and v7.5.0 entries. (6) Log4j-style logging enhanced: added FileAppender class to src/utils/logger.js with rolling 5MB file rotation, wired into server.js to persist all server logs to logs/server.log (console + file dual appender). (7) i18n cleanup: migrated remaining hardcoded strings (Edge CDP, Restart App, Retry Render, etc.) to t() i18n calls across App.jsx, main.jsx, and 15 other component/page files with 75+ new translation keys added to en.json/zh.json. (8) Browser verification: 11+ pages verified working without console errors.
